idealGroupBound.scope: Ideal real-arithmetic envelope from uploaded Float32 inputs; not an outward-rounded Float32 shader guarantee. Production must add documented approximation/accumulation error allowance.

ledger.units: metres, isotropic emitter variance m2, current modulated raw RGB reference before camera/P/transmission

provenance.massIndependence: Multiplying every packet mass by7 leaves all uploaded packet words bit-identical; mass does not enter average incident SH
provenance.sourceOrder: All1728 valid native Float32 ledger rows in original order; full14000-capacity buffer reconstructed with zero suffix
provenance.units: Existing trace-isotropic Gaussian raw incident SH1; eachattachmentRGBA=(C0,C1x,C1y,C1z), C1 signed; no alpha, packet mass, display exposure, SSA or smoke self-shadow in this field

rawBound.limits: Bound for normalized isotropic Gaussian packet/emitter SH1 model only. No incoming smoke shadow, anisotropic conditional-ray field, scene-wide energy conservation, packet-count multiplier or measured photometry.

margin.groupSumPrecision: binary64 positive-sum gamma(count-1) applied after uploaded-row verification

rawBound.method: max over uploaded packets/channels of sum(group RGB)*min(1/b,2/dAABB²)*(1+3|g|)/(4pi), with declared FP32/special-function margin
